title: Coefficientwise algebra map on dual numbers
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field], let $R,S$ be commutative $k$-algebras, and let $h:R\to S$ be a homomorphism of $k$-algebras [def-weil-pbc-algebra-hom-quotient]. Write $R[\epsilon],S[\epsilon]$ for their dual-number algebras [def-sc-dual-numbers]. The induced coefficient map $h[\epsilon]:R[\epsilon]\to S[\epsilon]$ is the $k$-algebra homomorphism given by $a+b\epsilon\mapsto h(a)+h(b)\epsilon$.

source.place: 10.18--10.19, printed pp.191--192: functoriality of dual-number points under coefficient-algebra homomorphisms.
